title: First-boot trust recovery can re-anchor noninitial mutable state after floor loss
description: Security review of so3l/0919 integration: when manifest stage is before TRUST and gateway-trust.bin exists but the external trust floor is missing, lichend loads the sealed store with minimum_generation=0 and recreates the floor from whatever signed generation/entries are present. The legitimate crash boundary can only produce the initial empty generation-1 store; accepting any nonempty/higher store lets a rolled-back stage-0 manifest plus missing floor re-anchor mutable trust state. Require exactly generation 1 and zero entries before recovering a store-only first-boot partial; add positive initial-partial and negative noninitial-partial tests.
close_reason: Fixed: trust resume extracted into recover_or_provision_trust_store with validate-in-memory-first ordering - gate (gen 1 AND empty) runs before ANY disk write; rejected partial leaves floor absent + manifest uncommitted on first attempt and retry. 2 new tests (positive initial-partial recovery, negative noninitial rejection incl. retry). 14/14 lichend bin tests pass. Guard drops verified behavior-preserving; slot path untouched (its pre-gate floor write tracked separately).
